title: Annotatio II NATIVITAS open: Inventors among Berengar’s confuters — PRIORIS Rupert of Deutz
pass_a_gloss: For the rest, among Berengar’s Confuters you will find without trouble Inventors both of the Crasser and of the Subtler Consubstantiation. Of the FORMER indeed Rupert Abbot of Deutz, John Gerhard confessing (Patrology p. 551) — therefore numbered neither by the Reformed, by the Most Reverend Forbes, nor by the Lutherans except in contumely, by Bayer’s Disputation on Impanation nos. 11, 21, and 22 — since Rupert himself betrays himself a crass Impanator by the exposition of his own sentence.
pass_b_english: Among Berengar’s confuters you easily find inventors of both crasser and subtler Consubstantiation.
Of the crasser: Rupert, Abbot of Deutz — Gerhard owns him; Forbes and Bayer list him only as insult — because Rupert’s own exposition brands him a crass Impanator.
source_text: Ceterum inter Berengarii Confutatores tam Crassioris, quam Subtilioris Consubstantiationis Inventores, nullo negotio repereris. PRIORIS quidem RUPERTUM TUITIENSEM Abbatem, fassô Johanne Gerhardô, Patrolog. p. 551. nequicquam ergò vel Reformatis, à Reverendiss. Forbesio, vel Lutheranis, nisi in contumeliam, a Bajero Disput. de Impanat. num. 11. 21. & 22. annumeratum, cum ipse Rupertus semet crassum Impanatorem expositione sententiae suae prodat.
